evals.name: Drafts follow-up email with meeting notes

context_inputs.notes: Discussed Q3 priorities. Agreed to focus on mobile app launch. Action items: Alice to draft timeline, Bob to review budget.

llmOutputs.draftBody:
Hi team,

Thank you for taking the time to meet for our Q3 planning session.

Key takeaways:
- We agreed to prioritize the mobile app launch
- Alice will draft the project timeline
- Bob will review the budget allocation

Please let me know if I missed anything or if you have questions.

Best regards
